name: Jūshiyama (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Jūshiyama village emblem in white: a crescent of concentric arcs beneath a cross-shaped device.
history: Flag of the former village of Jūshiyama in Aichi Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-04-01. Flag and emblem were adopted on 3 November 1986.

features.role: Jūshiyama village emblem — a crescent of concentric arcs beneath a cross-shaped device
